scope: Preview-only Phase A explicit atomic evidence, conservative adjudication, append-only owner review and actionable Chief reporting. No paid calls, credentials, historical acceptance rewrite or operational authority.
riskAnalysis: Reviewer identity, evidence and acceptance boundaries are critical. Preserve independent QA and backend decisions, reject stale/tampered/replayed claims, distinguish offline evaluator mechanics from actual model accuracy.

threatModel.assets: Immutable original screenshots, model outputs, QA, task acceptance, owner identity and retained financial ledger.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Model statement to backend atoms; capture geometry to proposition; local PNG to manifest; authenticated owner to CAS review; original task release to current surface.
threatModel.abuseCases: Unreviewed summary, reversed geometry, whole-image citation bridge, self-review, foreign task, stale binding, duplicate submission, UI read/file race, gold leakage, uncertain delivery.
threatModel.mitigations: Shared strict schemas, canonical note/propositions, direct regional checks, same-document ownership, immutable hash projection, CAS/idempotency, file generations, visible pending journal, no authority from review.

rollback: Keep paid disabled and no approvals. Revert only Phase A feature commits and deploy disabled Preview; preserve all original evidence, appended reviews, accounting, central revocation and Production.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Explicit claim/schema validation, summary/polarity/region negatives and frozen live-response replay before any transport.
negativePaths.stale-state: Task and global revision/hash/current release binding deny stale or altered owner review and report downgrade.
negativePaths.concurrency: Real Redis CAS and unit race tests enforce unique review record; active pilot/rehearsal blocks review mutation.
negativePaths.cancellation: Terminal review rejects changed/cancelled states; UI session loss invalidates in-flight reads and files; existing execution cancellation retained.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Tracked driver negative suites retained in mandatory STRICT union; no new worker executor or retry introduced.
negativePaths.api-outage: Redis read/CAS outage fails closed; lost review response retains exact key/payload and explicit reconciliation only.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No paid provider in this pass; existing15USD spending/revocation contracts remain mandatory; review has acceptedWorkfalse and no operational authority.
negativePaths.partial-execution: In-flight read/file races and lost commit response reproduced; no partial review can alter original workflow or silently create another submission.

defects.rootCause: Sentence-derived compound findings bundle readable layout with uncertain exact words.
defects.detectionGap: Prior synthetic findings were single simple statements and did not test supported subfact retention.
defects.regression: Frozen actual Piña response plus explicit three-claim Growth case retains two supported atoms and one insufficient atom.
defects.historicalPrevention: A new strict inspector must enumerate independent claims and cannot hide assertions in an unreviewed summary.

defects.rootCause: Draft region checks shared a bridging evidence box without checking each atomic region directly.
defects.detectionGap: Earlier same-image tests used small disjoint boxes and missed whole-image bridging.
defects.regression: Whole-image bridge, unrelated same-image and mixed relevant/unrelated observation tests fail.
defects.historicalPrevention: Every explicit claim citation must directly overlap its declared region, with bounded evidence area.

defects.rootCause: Owner review read/file promises could restore stale state and uncertain submissions lacked an accessible durable key.
defects.detectionGap: Source substring tests did not execute asynchronous UI races or lost-response recovery.
defects.regression: Actual script VM behavioral tests cover task changes, file validation order, session loss and lost committed response reconciliation.
defects.historicalPrevention: Generations invalidate stale responses; origin-scoped pending journal preserves exact replay without automatic retry.

proactiveReview.architecture: Reuse five-stage supervisor/worker/shared schemas and existing owner API, Redis CAS and audit; separate appended review never replaces historical acceptance.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Node builtins, browser WebCrypto/FileReader and pinned Playwright only; no package, credential, database or external service added.
proactiveReview.threats: Summary/measurement substitution, irrelevant evidence bridges, self approval, foreign workspace, replay and leaked evaluation gold are challenged explicitly.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Uncertain image text remains unresolved; aggregate bytes, stale release, storage failure and unsupported review ownership deny safely before consequential work.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Actual UI script promises, provider-boundary mocks, historical frozen response, Redis CAS races and existing interrupted-worker tests.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate QA and Auditor inspected actual source, original PNGs and request/review paths; confirmed draft defects were corrected with regressions.
proactiveReview.recovery: Preserve immutable originals and unknown charges; lost owner review submission uses saved exact idempotency payload, never an automatic retry or task resurrection.
proactiveReview.readiness: STRICT complete regression/contract union, Redis, CI, CodeQL and authenticated Preview still required; offline tests do not prove improved live model accuracy.
